messages.subject: ylim (yaxs = "i")
parts:
Hi There,

I'm trying to find the way to control my y axis limits so that they
range from exactly 0 to exactly 1. Currently when I set

+ ylim(c(0,1))

the axis limits are extended slightly. In effect I am asking for
ggplots equivalent of how to change yaxs="r" to yaxs="i"

Many thanks

Joe

messages.subject: Re: ylim (yaxs = "i")
parts:
many thanks

interestingly if I use

+ylim(0,1) + scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))

then the y limits are the limits of the data. in order to actually set
the min and max to be 0 and 1 I need to use

scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0),limits=c(0,1))

Is this behavior (i.e. the overriding of ylim by scale_y_continuous)
intentional?

Joe
